purpose: Measure program and target-indication sizing/observability under a registry-observable progression endpoint; not a trained or locked clinical benchmark.
prior_exposure: 24 purposive cases and P01/P24 advancement leads exposed; crude contemporary pair counts inspected. No performance-selected endpoint or untouched-test claim.

endpoint_tiers.A: First distinct next-numerical-phase interventional NCT for same resolved drug/product composition and normalized indication, with ACTUAL registry study-start date in (origin, endpoint] and public registry posting no later than the observation snapshot/cutoff. This is enrollment/development progression, not experimental dosing or efficacy.
endpoint_tiers.B: Unmodified v0.3 experimental-regimen first-dosing audit tier. Incomplete higher-specificity evidence, not a perfect gold reference.
endpoint_tiers.C: Separate descriptive any-arm initiation, efficacy, safety and administrative events; never collapsed to biological success.

eligibility.origin_start: ACTUAL date on/before origin; missing/estimated dates remain unresolved rather than assumed enrolled
eligibility.higher_phase_before_origin: Exclude same resolved program from that edge if actual qualifying higher-phase start is already known at origin; ambiguous prior advancement remains unresolved.
excluded: Phase 3 or later for primary origin route
eligibility.mixed_phase: PHASE1/PHASE2 and PHASE2/PHASE3 remain separately counted unresolved unless arm-specific dated stage is established. No numeric collapsing.
eligibility.within_trial_phase_change: Not counted from a phase-field change or the original enrollment date; requires separate cohort-stage evidence. Primary registry route uses distinct NCT IDs.

drug_role_and_regimen.automatic_resolved_subset: Drug/Biological interventions linked to an EXPERIMENTAL arm; one uniquely resolved active product, explicit arm-title product/alias match, no conflicting arm/intervention description and no comparator/rescue/background role cue. Preserve source strings and rule reasons.
drug_role_and_regimen.multiple_active_products: Retain full composition as combination candidate; never assign all linked components to individual monotherapy programs. Unresolved active roles or supportive components require audit before resolved count.
drug_role_and_regimen.ambiguous_roles: EXPERIMENTAL membership alone is insufficient. Unknown role is an unresolved candidate, not a non-event or zero.
drug_role_and_regimen.dose_population: Tier A is a product-composition/indication development surrogate. Preserve dose/route/line/genotype differences as scope flags and audit/sensitivity strata; no claim that every dose/population advanced. New product, ADC payload or active composition requires separate identity.

normalization.drug: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; unique exact alias among molecule name/synonyms/tradeNames or explicit source identifier. No fuzzy matching, no automatic parent/salt/ADC-payload merging and no stripping numeric identity. Multiple matches unresolved.
normalization.condition_primary: Unicode NFKC, casefold and whitespace normalization of verbatim condition; preserve disease subtype, stage, genotype and negation. Exact normalized string is the automatic baseline.
normalization.condition_sensitivity: Explicit unique ontology-equivalent aliases may be studied only with a separately frozen mapping/version before that count. No automatic descendant or broad family merging.
normalization.mechanism: Use chemblIds-to-targets as a multivalued mapping; record all targets and missingness. Later target knowledge is oracle mapping for sizing, not historical feature evidence.

event_rules.date_type: ACTUAL only for resolved event count; estimated/unknown dates separately tabulated
event_rules.availability: study_first_posted_date and last_update_posted_date must be within each source snapshot/cutoff; a later report of an earlier start cannot silently enter the earlier ascertainment count
event_rules.phase_identity: Same program composition/normalized indication and allowed numerical phase edge; separately report shared-target different-drug coincidences
event_rules.date_precision: Preserve original date strings/precision; month-only bounds straddling a boundary unresolved, never invent a day
event_rules.duplicate_event: Canonical next NCT plus resolved product composition and event type; shared predecessors/conditions/reports count once as a development event and retain their rollups/dependency links
event_rules.contradictions: Preserve conflicting ACTUAL dates, withdrawal/enrollment contradictions, intervention links and role disagreements; adjudicate before promoting resolved counts

no_recorded_transition: Report no recorded advancement by cutoff under measured search/mapping coverage. This is not biological failure or a defensible individual censoring date; incomplete coverage is unresolved.

estimands.primary: Resolved drug-product-composition × normalized-indication programs active at origin, stratified by phase edge
secondary: one origin-selected representative program per target-indication, deterministic earliest origin study-first-posted then NCT tie break; chosen without outcomes
counts: unique event NCTs and dependency components
estimands.representative_selection: Record full origin ranking before follow-up joins; no favorable-outcome replacement.
estimands.strict_vs_relaxed: Report resolved subset and uncertainty strata, not mathematical lower/upper bounds on true prevalence.

audit.sampling: Deterministic random seed 20261017; stratify by phase edge, mapping ambiguity, regimen complexity and snapshot/reporting interval. Adjust allocations to available strata and record inclusion probabilities. Do not use the sample to select better-performing endpoint definitions.
audit.review: Two separately recorded annotations where feasible, including an independent human for scientific validation/publication. AI-only exploration may proceed but is not independent gold.
metrics: Tier A precision and agreement with uncertainty
unresolved rate and minutes per case
recall only with a systematic independent event search of weighted sampled non-transitions
kappa as agreement, not proof of validity

power_plan.method: Simulate or resample measured dependency components across prevalence, score-correlation, effect-size and label-error scenarios. No empirical discrimination claim before actual predictions.
outputs: effective independent units and positive counts
power_plan.decision: Proceed only if audited mappings and attainable independent/event counts support an affordable design under explicit assumptions; otherwise revise design or methods/T6 fallback. Missing cost/validity inputs yield an unresolved decision, not automatic go/no-go.

isolation: Evaluator-only products. No labels, future mappings or gold answers in agent-visible manifests. No model-provider calls or scorer training in this milestone.
implementation_status: Protocol only; registry-scale SQL extraction, role mapping, event enumeration, sample audit and power simulation not run.
